data.one_liner: Run workout sessions and stream live health data from Wear OS and Tizen.
data.what_it_does: The package lets you start a workout session on Wear OS or Tizen and receive real‑time data such as heart rate, calories, steps, speed and distance. It also provides a method to launch a watchOS app from iOS.
use_when: Need live health metrics on Wear OS or Tizen
Want a single plugin for multiple wearable platforms
Require integration with Flutter without writing native code
avoid_when: You only need Android sensor data
You need a fully featured iOS watchOS app
You want a lightweight solution without native permissions
strengths: Supports multiple wearable OSes (Wear OS, Tizen, watchOS via iOS)
Provides real‑time streaming of key fitness metrics
Minimal dependencies, easy to add to existing projects
weaknesses: Requires native permission configuration and platform‑specific setup
No support for Android phones alone (only wearables)
Limited to health data, no other sensor types
data.setup_notes: Add BODY_SENSORS, ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permissions in AndroidManifest; add healthinfo privilege and sensor features in Tizen manifest; enable HealthKit entitlement and Workout Processing background mode on iOS.
